[SWS_Eth_00328]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00173, SRS_BSW_00350, SRS_BSW_00386
⌈When calling the callback function EthIf_RxIndication, then the Ethernet driver
shall keep the affected EthCtrlConfigIngressQueue element locked, until Eth_
ReleaseRxBuffer is called with RxHandleId associated with the affected EthC-
trlConfigIngressQueue element.⌋
Note: Eth_ReleaseRxBuffer could be called by the upper layer in context of the
EthIf_RxIndication.
